extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I attempted to falsify the no-issue verdict by testing whether the reported claim actually requires the complete 96-station domain despite the subset denominator. I examined task.md L0001, which states the scientific question is 'conditional on passing a prespecified signal screen'; results/report.md L0004, which names the target population as the 72 signal-eligible stations; and the selected-result line, which is explicitly prefixed 'Among signal-eligible stations'. I then checked whether any sentence generalises the 25% figure to the scheduled network and found none — the only complete-domain mention (L0003) is bare context, and L0005 explicitly records the 24 excluded stations as not assessed. Because the target is explicitly conditional on the retained subset, the in-scope mismatch is excluded by definition.
